qualification.details: Para legal Personnel /lawyer: Degree in Law, Legal training, Knowledge of laws. Experience: At least 3 years experience of working within a government or non-government women related project/programme at the district level or to any practicing Lawyer with at least 2 years experience of litigation in any court of law. Psycho-Social Counselor: Professional degree / diploma in psychology / psychiatry / neurosciences, Background in health sector. Experience: At least 3 years experience of working within a government or non-government health project/programme at the district level. Case Workers: Bachelor in Law, Social Work, Social Sciences, Psychology. Experience: At least 3 years experience of working on women related relevant domains in a government or non-government Project/programme. Multi-Purpose staff(3 nos) (Helper) and 1 post for OSC, Chittoor (women only): Literate, Knowledge / experience of working in the relevant domain, High School pass or equivalent will be preferred. Security Guard/Night Guard (women only): Security personnel experience. Experience: At least 2 years experience of working as security personnel in a government or reputed organization at the district/state level. Preferably retired military / para-military personnel.

Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://chittoor.ap.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 17-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DW&CW&EO Chittoor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the DW&CW&EO Chittoor Recruitment 2026 is 17th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies announced for various posts in the District Women And Child Welfare Department Chittoor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum age requirement for the posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for all the posts is 25 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 42 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salaries range from Rs. 13,000/- to Rs. 20,000/- per month, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q7. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification varies by post, ranging from High School pass to a Degree in Law, Psychology, Social Work, Social Sciences, or Health Sciences.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an oral interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Women And Child Welfare Department Chittoor.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to submit photocopies of educational qualifications, experience certificates, and community certificates along with the application form.
